title: Cross-sectional dispersion metrics: cross-sectional volatility (std across coins
description: Cross-sectional dispersion metrics: cross-sectional volatility (std across coins per timestamp, averaged over period), hierarchical correlation clusters (2-5 groups, avg intra-cluster correlation), diffusion indexes (7d/30d % of coins with positive return), advance-decline ratio, new highs/lows percentages. Periods: 7d/30d/90d. Informational research data — not investment advice.
